name: openai-to-gemini-transformer
description: Translates OpenAI Chat Completions requests into the Google Gemini generateContent API format and rewrites non-streaming Gemini responses back into the OpenAI response shape. Maps messages to contents, system prompts to systemInstruction, tools to functionDeclarations, and multi-modal image input. Supports both routed (multi-provider) and unconditional (single-provider) execution modes.
